meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Resend 邮件发送通道到聊天应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天应用中添加邮件发送能力
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Resend email channel into your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add email sending to a chat application

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过 Resend 收发邮件，实现异步邮件对话。它会自动注册邮件通道，并让你通过邮件与指定智能体交流。
howto.when: 当你完成 Resend 账号、域名验证、API 密钥和 Webhook 设置，并运行连接指令后触发。

say.text: 帮我连接我的邮箱，设置 Resend 邮件通道。
say.note: 开始执行技能中的配置步骤。

say.text: 用我的邮箱 owner@example.com 注册为所有者。
say.note: 将你的邮箱设为所有者，并发送欢迎邮件。

say.text: 把邮件通道连接到智能体文件夹 my-agent。
say.note: 指定哪个智能体处理你的邮件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive emails via Resend for async conversations. It registers the email channel and lets you communicate with a specified agent through email.
howto.when_en: Triggered after you complete Resend account setup, domain verification, API key and webhook configuration, and run the connection commands.

say_en.text: Help me connect my email and set up the Resend channel.
say_en.note: Starts the configuration steps in the skill.

say_en.text: Register my email owner@example.com as the owner.
say_en.note: Sets your email as owner and sends a hello email.

say_en.text: Connect the email channel to agent folder my-agent.
say_en.note: Specifies which agent handles your emails.
